attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: No Yang-Mills computation yet identifies the leading quotient kernel H and proves the expansion is uniform for reflected Wilson hairpin triples.
steps: Start with fixed-collar reflection positivity: N_delta>=0. The intended target is not N_delta if collar collapse contributes Bhat_delta; it is the Schur preimage q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta.
Normalize diagonals to one. At exact collision the quotient base is J=11*, whose nullspace is the zero-sum subspace.
Insert the boundary OPE q_delta=J+eps_delta H+o(eps_delta). For any c with sum c_i=0, the J term vanishes, so c*q_delta c=eps_delta c*Hc+o(eps_delta).
If c*Hc<0, q_delta has a negative quadratic form for small delta; hence the same-theory OS block is indefinite although the collar block N_delta was positive.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The lemma is a valid necessary falsifier, not a positivity theorem; nonnegative H may still fail at higher order or larger finite minors.

assumptions: Fixed-collar OS matrices N_delta are PSD and converge entrywise for every finite reflected Wilson family.
Bhat_delta has nonzero entries and unit diagonal after the allowed diagonal congruence normalization.
The boundary OPE gives q_delta=J+eps_delta H+o(eps_delta) uniformly on the chosen finite block, with eps_delta>0.
The same Wilson observables label N_delta, B_delta, and the target block; no new boundary observable is inserted.
definitions: source object: fixed-collar reflected Wilson OS matrices N_delta obtained from regulated reflection-positive Schwinger forms after RG convergence.
target object: continuum OS-positive Schwinger functions on the locked gauge-invariant Wilson algebra, with no boundary counterterm or algebra change.
controlled interface: quotient Schur preimage q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta after diagonal normalization and removal of positive additive contacts.
same-theory condition: B_delta is only the collar-collapse boundary factor already present in the locked Wilson renormalization; q_delta, not a modified algebra, must be PSD.

equations.label: exact same-theory quotient
equations.valid_when: Multiplicative boundary factors are isolated and no entry of Bhat_delta vanishes.

equations.label: tangent expansion
equations.valid_when: The reflected Wilson boundary OPE has a uniform leading quotient kernel on the finite block.

equations.label: zero-sum obstruction
equations.latex: \sum_i c_i=0,\quad c^*Hc<0\ \Longrightarrow\ c^*q_\delta c<0\text{ for small }\delta
equations.valid_when: epsilon_delta is positive and the o(epsilon_delta) remainder is uniform for that vector c.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Compute H for a three-hairpin block; any zero-sum vector with c^*Hc<0 gives a concrete same-theory falsifier.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Necessary infinitesimal detector for failure of Schur-preimage OS positivity after Wilson collar collapse.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For a finite locked Wilson collar block, if the normalized same-theory quotient q_delta=Nhat_delta oslash Bhat_delta has expansion J+eps_delta H+o(eps_delta), then OS positivity of the intended limit forces H to be positive on the zero-sum subspace. A negative zero-sum form is a valid falsifier.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot if boundary OPE data show unavoidable negative zero-sum H or require boundary observables outside the locked algebra.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if H is zero-sum positive for a dense Wilson core and higher-order remainders preserve finite q_delta PSD.
control_decision.reason: The branch now has a computable leading-order determinant test rather than another topology slogan.

dependency_updates.description: Closed-cone passage is reduced, in Wilson boundary sectors, to finite PSD of q=Nhat oslash Bhat plus the tangent zero-sum detector.
The Wilson labels must remain locked through collar collapse; otherwise B can hide a theory change.
Topology must give entrywise convergence and a uniform boundary OPE remainder for finite reflected Wilson blocks.

falsifiers: falsifier: a reflected Wilson triple has q_delta determinant negative, equivalently a zero-sum vector detects c*Hc<0 at leading OPE order.
falsifier: Bhat_delta has zeros or nonuniform phases, so the Schur preimage is not a well-defined same-theory limit.
falsifier: additive boundary contacts survive despite diagonal trace continuity, invalidating the quotient-only reduction.
falsifier: proving positivity requires adding a boundary Wilson operator or changing loop renormalization, so the bridge is valid only for a different theory.
branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 213 adds an infinitesimal falsifier to the exact Schur-preimage bridge. If the quotient q_delta is near the rank-one matrix J, OS positivity first lives on the zero-sum tangent space. Thus the leading boundary OPE kernel H must be positive there; a negative zero-sum form is a valid finite Wilson obstruction before invoking log-CND or semigroups.
branch_outputs.next_experiment: Compute the leading quotient kernel H for three reflected Wilson hairpins with a common boundary footprint; test c=(1,-1,0) and c=(1,1,-2) zero-sum forms.
